svg.title: Orion Mesh
svg.desc: Two Raspberry Pis on NixOS, joined by a BATMAN-adv mesh, measure how much an H.264 stream on the same Wi-Fi channel delays 50 Hz ROS 2 control messages. Both SD images build from one flake. Pictures: The testbed: numbered parts on both boards, and what each one does in a trial.

text.tspan: Two Raspberry Pis on NixOS, joined by a BATMAN-adv mesh, measure how much an H.264 stream on the same Wi-Fi
channel delays 50 Hz ROS 2 control messages. Both SD images build from one flake.

svg.text: microSD: NixOS image from the flake
Clocks: kept in step by Chrony
SoC: times each message, logs CPU
microSD: image from the same flake
